title: A nonparametric test for diurnal variation in spot correlation processes
abstract: arXiv:2408.02757v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The association between log-price increments of exchange-traded equities, as measured by their spot correlation estimated from high-frequency data, exhibits a pronounced upward-sloping and almost piecewise linear relationship at the intraday horizon. There is notably lower-on average less positive-correlation in the morning than in the afternoon. We develop a nonparametric testing procedure to detect such variation in a correlation process. The test statistic has a known distribution under the null hypothesis, whereas it diverges under the alternative. We run a Monte Carlo simulation to discover the finite sample properties of the test statistic, which are close to the large sample predictions, even for small sample sizes and realistic levels of diurnal variation. translated_title: 即期相关过程日内变化的一种非参数检验
translated_abstract: 以基于高频数据估计的即期相关性来度量的交易所上市股票对数价格增量之间的关联性，在日内尺度上呈现出明显的向上倾斜且近似分段线性的关系。值得注意的是，平均而言上午的相关性（正相关性较弱）明显低于下午。我们开发了一种非参数检验方法来检测相关过程中的这种变化。该检验统计量在原假设下具有已知的分布，而在备择假设下则会发散。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟来考察该检验统计量的有限样本性质，结果表明即使在样本量较小且日内变化程度符合实际情况的情况下，其有限样本性质也与大样本预测非常接近。在实证应用中，我们将该检验应用于覆盖较长时间跨度的股票市场高频数据集，该检验在大多数情况下拒绝了原假设。
tldr: 本文提出了一种非参数检验方法来检测高频数据估计的即期相关过程中的日内变化，该检验统计量在原假设下具有已知分布，并实证发现股票市场上午的相关性显著低于下午。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a nonparametric test with a known null distribution to detect diurnal variation in spot correlation processes estimated from high-frequency data, empirically finding that stock market correlations are notably lower in the morning than in the afternoon.
